column3: The orchestrator row attaches the Captain Drive scope for a Captain and its crew threads through an optional ctx.inject(["drive"]); the automations row attaches the automation scope for every conversation a run of it went to, from a thread-to-automation map read once per object lifetime (automation_runs is capped at 50 runs per automation) and updated as runs start
column4: XIN-23 found no product code called attach, so /captains/<id>/ AGENTS.md and skills never reached anyone; optional inject keeps the orchestrator working with the drive row off; the source reads only the in-memory xin.captains and thread docs, so it costs 0 rows per request; DRIVE_SCOPE_ID widened to fit cpt_<commandId> ids
column5: plugins/orchestrator/captains.test.ts: captain.create, a drive.write of the Captain's AGENTS.md, then delegate_task; the crew thread's and the Captain's system sections both carry the instructions block; plugins/automations/automations.test.ts: a manual run's thread carries the automation AGENTS.md, and after an eviction drive.scopes still lists the automation scope
